title: 2K2P CPlugin
description: This is 2K2P Custom Plugin, a plugin that has some custom feature, self coding from another server features or ideas.
body:
2K2P is a plugin that coded for addings custom features from ideas on another servers or plugins, but this plugin is NOT taken any line of codes from ANY plugins, so feels free to use it!

![As You Can See:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d040138eac24742a6320a79e6edd6105c27c0192.png)

All things and commands it already has:
- bring, bringall, bringallto, allto, etc: teleporting players to players faster
- to, etc: teleporting yourself to player faster
- createpoll, poll, closepoll, unpoll: poll system (chat type)
- random: random system (broadcast)

All things and commands it will have (in developement):
- Custom items with custom models (like oraxen but much more lighweight)
- custom item modifier (like itemsedit but more lighweight)

How to use: You should have paper server installed, then put this plugin into /plugins folder, then youre done!

Hope you enjoy!
